directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: An upload can begin before its final length is known; positive pieces extend the arrived prefix at checked contiguous offsets.
An unfinished file can be read while pieces arrive, without publishing an immutable file identity or final name.
Stored piece identity and exact uploaded bytes determine the finished whole-file identity; final names bind only after verification.
Repeated upload operations preserve their original token and accepted bytes; cancellation removes provisional access.
Recent file uses retain newest-use order and preserve the actual wall-clock display time.
The bounded metadata validation and actual-byte hashing passes must agree on the same ordered span descriptors.
allowed_deltas: Use the existing Rust UPLOADS, SPANS and CHUNKS record scopes instead of the retired Worker SQLite tables; no second store.
The existing fixed pages-32k-v1 layout remains readable; pages-append-v1 records variable pieces, 256 per page, with checked ordinal and byte seams.
The token is a locator alongside the normal target name and fresh read authority, rather than a standalone provisional-identity authority.
Open-length append finish hashes bounded actual chunk reads; caller-supplied canonical identities and lengths are not accepted as evidence.
Existing recent ordering keys retain their format, with a bounded monotonic ordering tick when wall time ties or moves backward.
banned_substitutions: A new upload store or whole-file buffering.
Publishing a final identity or name before actual stored-byte verification.
Treating an upload token as authority or retrying an uncertain write under a new key.

baseline.note: Behavioral adaptation from the retired JavaScript owner into the existing native upload owner; no source-first byte-copy claim.

retirement_evidence.observed: The declared source repository retired its old Worker at retirement_commit. That commit deletes all three declared source paths, and all three paths are absent from published_main. The source repository and immutable path/content pins remain in sources[].
